role: official-sector-flow class member #3 (after MoF Japan and SNB); and a FREE OFFICIAL CARRY series for an in-universe pair -- 'carry' is one of the 8 REACHABLE-but-ABSENT families in the desk's own book-breadth report

endpoint_tags./pribor: Fixing of Interest Rates on Interbank Deposits (PRIBOR)

verification.method: pulled in 4-year chunks and DEDUPED on (date,pair,maturity)

known_failure_modes: SILENT SERVER-SIDE ROW CAP AT 10,000. A single request for dateFrom=2000-01-01&dateTo=2026-08-28 returns HTTP 200, no error, no truncation flag -- and exactly 10000 rows ending 2010-08-04. The chunked pull returns 26523 obs to 2026-08-28, so the naive single read SILENTLY LOSES 62% of the series and ends 16 YEARS EARLY while every value in it stays plausible. MUST be pulled in chunks (4 years is safe: max chunk observed 4044) and deduped. This is the desk's ranked lesson #4 (paginate every venue history endpoint) reproduced on a new source.

PARAMETER NAMES ARE NOT WHAT THE RESPONSE FIELDS SUGGEST: the response carries 'ccyPair' and 'validFor', but the query params are 'currencyPair', 'dateFrom', 'dateTo'. Wrong names return HTTP 400 with a JSON body naming the field -- read api-docs, do not infer params from the response schema.

lang=EN DOES NOT LOCALISE ENUM VALUES on /omo: operationType returns 'Depozitni facilita' and liquidityImpact returns 'Stazeni' (Czech) even with lang=EN. A consumer filtering on English strings gets ZERO rows and reads it as 'no operations'.
EUR_TO_CZK has 6369 dates vs USD_TO_CZK 6893 -- the EUR series starts later (the koruna's EUR forward quoting began after the USD one). A joined frame silently truncates to the shorter series.
forward POINTS, not outright rates -- they must be combined with the spot fixing (/exrates) to form a rate, and the points' scale/sign convention is CNB's own.
economic_story: The CNB is a forced participant with a public record: it ran an EXPLICIT EURCZK 27.00 floor from 2013-11 to 2017-04 -- the same mechanism as the SNB's EURCHF floor -- and its open market operations (/omo, full bid/allotment detail) are published daily. CZK is in the live 251-symbol universe. The forward points give the carry leg; /omo gives the intervention/liquidity leg.
residual_unverified: the /omo series was opened and confirmed rich (242KB for 2015 alone) but was NOT pulled in full or diffed against the floor episode this run -- that is the named next unit, and it is UNVERIFIED, not adopted.
